meta.name: 2D Fighter Template
meta.description: Complete animation requirements for a 2D fighting game character. Defines every sprite state needed, frame counts, hitbox data, and generation prompts.
meta.notes: sprite_size can be 'auto' (detect from input image), or explicit like '64x96'. Frame counts are recommendations — user can adjust.

movement.label: Core Movement
movement.description: Basic locomotion — every fighter needs these

standing_attacks.label: Standing Attacks
standing_attacks.description: Normal attacks while standing (6 buttons: LP, SP, LK, SK + close variants)

hit_reactions.label: Hit Reactions
hit_reactions.description: How the character reacts to getting hit

system.label: System Animations
system.description: Intro, win pose, KO, time over

states.name: idle
states.label: Idle / Standing
states.description: Standing neutral pose. Subtle breathing/weight shift animation. The 'default' state everything returns to.
states.generation_prompt: idle standing animation, subtle breathing movement, character standing neutral, weight shifting slightly between feet

states.name: stand_to_crouch
states.label: Stand to Crouch Transition
states.description: Transition from standing to crouching. Quick dip downward.
states.generation_prompt: character transitioning from standing to crouching pose, knees bending, body lowering
common_issues: teleporting to crouch instead of transitioning

states.name: crouch_idle
states.label: Crouching Idle
states.description: Crouching pose, ready to act. Low profile for dodging high attacks.
states.generation_prompt: character crouching low, knees bent, ready stance, slight idle movement
common_issues: too tall (should be roughly half standing height)

states.name: crouch_to_stand
states.label: Crouch to Stand Transition
states.description: Transition from crouching back to standing.
states.generation_prompt: character rising from crouch to standing position, straightening legs

states.name: walk_forward
states.label: Walk Forward
states.description: Walking toward opponent. Must alternate legs correctly — left foot forward then right foot forward.
states.generation_prompt: walking forward animation, character moving toward viewer, alternating leg stride, natural walking motion
common_issues: both legs doing the same thing

states.name: walk_backward
states.label: Walk Backward
states.description: Walking away from opponent (retreating). Typically mirrors walk forward but with defensive posture.
states.generation_prompt: walking backward animation, character retreating, defensive posture, alternating leg stride moving backward
common_issues: same as walk forward but flipped (should be distinct)

states.name: jump_start
states.label: Jump Start (Pre-Jump)
states.description: Crouching down before the jump. Anticipation frame. Player is still grounded.
states.generation_prompt: character squatting down before jumping, anticipation pose, knees deeply bent, about to launch upward

states.name: jump_rise
states.label: Jump Rising
states.description: Character moving upward through the air. Legs tucked or extended depending on style.
states.generation_prompt: character jumping upward, airborne, rising motion, legs tucked or extended, dynamic upward pose

states.name: jump_fall
states.label: Jump Falling
states.description: Character descending through the air. Peak of jump has been reached.
states.generation_prompt: character falling downward through air, descending motion, gravity pulling down, arms slightly raised
common_issues: identical to jump rise (should show different pose)

states.name: jump_land
states.label: Landing
states.description: Character touching ground after jump. Impact recovery. Knees absorb shock.
states.generation_prompt: character landing from a jump, knees bent absorbing impact, touching down on ground, recovery pose

states.name: run_forward
states.label: Run Forward
states.description: Full sprint toward opponent. Faster than walk, more dynamic. Leaning forward.
states.generation_prompt: running forward animation, full sprint, leaning forward, dynamic running motion, arms pumping, legs alternating at speed
common_issues: looks like fast walk instead of run
both feet off ground every frame (unnatural)

states.name: hop_back
states.label: Hop Back / Backdash
states.description: Quick backward hop to create distance. Defensive repositioning move. Can be invincible on startup in some games.
states.generation_prompt: character hopping backward, quick defensive leap away, body leaning back, feet leaving ground, backward momentum
common_issues: looks like jump (should be shorter/hop height)

states.name: stand_light_punch
states.label: Standing Light Punch
states.description: Quick jab. Fast startup, low damage, good for combos. Recovery returns to idle.
states.generation_prompt: quick jab punch animation, fast straight punch forward, fist extending, quick snap motion, light attack
common_issues: too slow/telegraphed for a light attack

states.name: stand_strong_punch
states.label: Standing Strong Punch
states.description: Heavy punch. Slower startup, more damage, more recovery. Significant wind-up.
states.generation_prompt: strong powerful punch animation, wind-up pulling fist back, powerful forward strike, heavy impact pose, strong attack

states.name: stand_light_kick
states.label: Standing Light Kick
states.description: Quick kick. Short range, fast. Usually aimed low.
states.generation_prompt: quick light kick animation, fast snapping kick, low kick extending forward, quick recovery, light kick attack

states.name: stand_strong_kick
states.label: Standing Strong Kick
states.description: Heavy kick. Roundhouse or thrust kick. More range and damage than light kick.
states.generation_prompt: strong kick animation, powerful roundhouse or thrust kick, full leg extension, heavy kicking motion, dynamic strong kick
common_issues: looks like light kick with more frames

states.name: crouch_light_punch
states.label: Crouching Light Punch
states.description: Quick punch while crouching. Low profile attack.
states.generation_prompt: crouching punch animation, character in low crouch position throwing a quick punch forward, low attack from crouch
common_issues: character standing up to punch (must stay crouched)

states.name: crouch_strong_punch
states.label: Crouching Strong Punch
states.description: Heavy crouching punch. Often an uppercut that hits opponents above.
states.generation_prompt: crouching uppercut animation, character rising slightly with powerful upward punch, anti-air crouch attack, strong crouching punch
common_issues: character fully standing (should stay mostly crouched)
punch going forward instead of up

states.name: crouch_light_kick
states.label: Crouching Light Kick
states.description: Quick low sweep kick. Hits opponents' feet. Must be blocked low.
states.generation_prompt: crouching low kick animation, character sweeping leg along the ground, low sweep kick from crouch position
common_issues: kick going too high (must be ground level)

states.name: crouch_strong_kick
states.label: Crouching Strong Kick
states.description: Heavy sweep kick. Trips the opponent. Knockdown move.
states.generation_prompt: crouching sweep kick animation, full leg sweep along ground, powerful low sweep that would trip opponent, spinning low kick from crouch

states.name: jump_light_punch
states.label: Jump Light Punch
states.description: Quick punch while airborne. Used for air-to-air or jump-in pressure.
states.generation_prompt: airborne punch animation, character in mid-air throwing a quick punch downward or forward, aerial attack pose
common_issues: character looks grounded (must be clearly airborne)

states.name: jump_strong_punch
states.label: Jump Strong Punch
states.description: Heavy punch while airborne. Big damage jump-in attack.
states.generation_prompt: powerful aerial punch animation, character in mid-air with heavy downward punch, strong jump-in attack, dynamic airborne strike
common_issues: wind-up too long for airborne state
not enough downward force in pose

states.name: jump_light_kick
states.label: Jump Light Kick
states.description: Quick kick while airborne. Fast air-to-air option.
states.generation_prompt: airborne kick animation, character in mid-air doing a quick kick, aerial kick attack, light air kick

states.name: jump_strong_kick
states.label: Jump Strong Kick
states.description: Heavy kick while airborne. Often a dropkick or axe kick.
states.generation_prompt: powerful aerial kick animation, character in mid-air with heavy kick extending downward, dynamic jump-in kick, strong air attack
common_issues: motion blur on the kick leg

states.name: stand_block
states.label: Standing Block
states.description: Blocking while standing. Arms in defensive position. Only blocks high/mid attacks.
states.generation_prompt: character blocking with arms raised in defensive stance, standing guard position, arms crossed or raised to protect face and torso
common_issues: looks like idle (should be clearly blocking)

states.name: crouch_block
states.label: Crouching Block
states.description: Blocking while crouching. Only blocks low attacks.
states.generation_prompt: character crouching and blocking, low defensive stance with arms protecting lower body, crouching guard position
common_issues: same as standing block but lower

states.name: air_block
states.label: Air Block
states.description: Blocking while airborne. Character floats slightly during block.
states.generation_prompt: character blocking in mid-air, aerial guard pose, arms raised defensively while airborne, floating defensive position

states.name: stand_hit_high
states.label: Standing Hit Reaction (High)
states.description: Getting hit by a high/mid attack while standing. Head snaps back, body recoils.
states.generation_prompt: character getting hit in the face or torso, recoiling backward, head snapping back, taking a hit reaction, pain expression
common_issues: looks like a pose not a reaction

states.name: stand_hit_low
states.label: Standing Hit Reaction (Low)
states.description: Getting hit by a low attack while standing. Body doubles over.
states.generation_prompt: character getting hit in the legs or stomach area, body doubling over in pain, low hit reaction, bending from the hit
common_issues: same as high hit (should be distinct — body folds forward)

states.name: air_hit
states.label: Air Hit Reaction
states.description: Getting hit while airborne. Character tumbles through the air.
states.generation_prompt: character getting hit while in the air, tumbling backward, spinning from impact, airborne hit reaction, ragdoll-like in air
common_issues: looks like a pose not a reaction

states.name: trip_hit
states.label: Tripped Hit Reaction
states.description: Getting swept/tripped. Character falls to the ground sideways.
states.generation_prompt: character being tripped, falling sideways to the ground, legs swept out from under them, horizontal falling animation

states.name: knockdown
states.label: Knocked Down / Lying Down
states.description: Character on the ground after being knocked down. Lying on back or face.
states.generation_prompt: character lying on the ground knocked down, fallen flat on back, defeated lying pose on the floor, knockdown state
common_issues: looks like a crouch (must be horizontal)

states.name: getup
states.label: Getting Up
states.description: Character recovering from knockdown. Rolling to feet. Often has invincibility frames.
states.generation_prompt: character getting up from the ground, rolling to standing position, recovery animation from knockdown, rising from lying down
common_issues: too fast (should show a recovery process)

states.name: ground_recovery
states.label: Ground Tech / Recovery
states.description: Quick recovery on ground. Character pops back up instantly instead of lying down. Timed input.
states.generation_prompt: character quickly rolling and popping back to feet, fast recovery roll, tech roll animation, instant ground recovery
common_issues: same as getup (should be faster/more energetic)

states.name: win_pose
states.label: Victory Pose
states.description: Character's victory animation after winning a round. Personality moment.
states.generation_prompt: character celebrating victory, confident triumphant pose, victory animation, character showing personality after winning
common_issues: too subtle (should be a clear celebration)
looping (should end on a held pose)

states.name: draw
states.label: Draw / Time Over
states.description: Animation for when time runs out. Usually a frustrated or neutral reaction.
states.generation_prompt: character reacting to time running out, frustrated or disappointed gesture, draw animation, looking annoyed

states.name: intro
states.label: Intro Animation
states.description: Character entrance animation at round start. Establishes personality.
states.generation_prompt: character introduction entrance animation, dramatic entry pose, round start intro, walking in and taking fighting stance
common_issues: ending pose doesn't match idle (jarring transition)

states.name: ko_fall
states.label: KO Fall
states.description: Character falling down after being KO'd. Dramatic final hit reaction.
states.generation_prompt: character being knocked out, dramatic fall to the ground, defeated KO animation, collapsing after final blow

states.name: special_1
states.label: Special Move 1 (Projectile)
states.description: Projectile special (e.g., Hadouken). Wind-up, release, recovery. Projectile sprite generated separately.
states.generation_prompt: character performing a projectile attack motion, wind-up then thrusting hands forward to release energy, special move fireball
common_issues: release frame not distinct from wind-up

states.name: special_2
states.label: Special Move 2 (Anti-Air)
states.description: Rising anti-air attack (e.g., Dragon Punch). Character leaps upward with an attack.
states.generation_prompt: character performing a rising uppercut attack, leaping upward with fist extended, dragon punch anti-air special move, powerful rising strike
common_issues: fist not leading the upward motion

states.name: special_3
states.label: Special Move 3 (Command Attack)
states.description: Unique character-specific move. Custom input and properties.
states.generation_prompt: character performing a unique special attack, character-specific fighting technique, distinctive special move animation

states.name: super_1
states.label: Level 1 Super
states.description: Super move. Dramatic wind-up with flash, multi-hit or powerful single hit. Uses meter.
states.generation_prompt: character performing a dramatic super move, intense energy gathering then explosive attack, super combo animation, flashy powerful special
common_issues: not dramatic enough for a super

min_viable_set.label: Minimum Viable Fighter
min_viable_set.description: The bare minimum animations to have a playable character

standard_set.label: Standard Fighter
standard_set.description: Everything needed for a competitive-quality character
